# COMEX raw-field regressions

source-rows.json contains literal field strings from original CSV rows 278,
299, 410 and 411 (header is row 1), covering January 2015, October 2016 and
January/February 2026. Original SHA256:
fff1819762f5783d25204e1cc388156b6d803c5a3ef525e3fa0a51a6f494127a.
These are raw-source snapshots, not expected outputs generated by the parser.
Tests assert separately inspected totals and discrepancies and compare against
raw XLS cell fixtures without choosing a winning edition or attributing causes.

OriginalComexTests additionally compares snapshots directly to csv.DictReader
on the untouched original and verifies the full 417-month series. It explicitly
skips if the original is absent (ICA_OFFICIAL_FIXTURES_DIR or /workspace/attachments).
No downloads, databases or publication are involved. No original binary/file
is copied into the repository. Snapshot CSV reserialization is only a test
input; it is not presented as the original byte stream or an economic oracle.
